scenarioTitle: Contain and Repair Damaged Work Safely — detect, preserve, contain, bound automation, verified closure

version.userStoryTitle: Contain and Repair Damaged Work Safely

criteria.statement: Damaged governance work is detected and surfaced in a prioritized queue, highest-attention first.
criteria.evidence: queue lists 6 case(s) in non-increasing priority; row[0] needsHumanAttention=true
criteria.negativeControl: the verified-closed case has the lowest priority and needsHumanAttention=false — not surfaced first

criteria.statement: The original of a damaged item is preserved and independently verifiable as intact.
criteria.evidence: original intact=true; captured digest === verify digest (sha256:preserved-original-abc)
criteria.negativeControl: the EMPTY comparison reports originalIntact=false — an un-fed view cannot masquerade as intact

criteria.statement: Ownership is a named owner or an explicit gap — never a fabricated owner.
criteria.negativeControl: the detected-preserved row has a named owner and ownershipGap=false — the gap is scenario-specific

criteria.statement: A quarantine contains the damaged effect (blocks downstream use) while keeping the item inspectable.
criteria.negativeControl: the EMPTY comparison reports quarantineContains=false — no active quarantine, no false containment claim

criteria.statement: Only a bounded, pre-authorized low-risk plan may execute automatically; a destructive plan must not.
criteria.evidence: auto plan isAutomaticEligible=true; destructive plan eligible=false; execute enabled=true
criteria.negativeControl: the destructive needs-approval plan is NOT automatic-eligible — execute would be gated for it

criteria.statement: A successful repair is succeeded-unverified, not closed — closure is a separate verification act.
criteria.negativeControl: the verified-closed detail carries caseClosed=true only because its verification passed

criteria.statement: A case is closed only when an independent verification passes all nine closure gates.
criteria.evidence: domain verdict=passed; detail caseClosed=true, gates=9 all passed
criteria.negativeControl: the auto-repaired detail is NOT closed (0 gates verified) — a source-reported "done" never closes a case
